entities.name: Louis, Landgrave of Hesse-Philippsthal

entities.summary: Louis of Hesse-Philippsthal was a German nobleman and a general. He fought for the Kingdom of Naples. From 1813 until his death, he was the ruling Landgrave of Hesse-Philippsthal.
